## About me

My name is **Zheyre Tolliver**. I am a student at [New College of Florida](https://www.ncf.edu), majoring in Psychology and Creative Writing. I built this site for ISC2076 because I wanted to understand why people pay to feel afraid and why they pay to laugh.

- **Email:** [zheyret@gmail.com](mailto:zheyret@gmail.com)

## About the data

This site uses two datasets shared through [TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday), a weekly data project from the R community. The [movie profit data](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2018/2018-10-23) comes from [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com) and lists the budget and box office earnings of 3,364 Hollywood movies released from 1936 to 2018, which I narrowed to five genres. The [horror movie data](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2022/2022-11-01) comes from [The Movie Database (TMDB)](https://www.themoviedb.org) and describes about 32,000 horror movies, including their plot summaries, release dates, and audience ratings.
